# Commercial Pricing & Profitability Analytics (B2B Specialty Catalysts)

A formula-driven Excel model that answers three commercial-finance questions for a B2B specialty-catalyst business:
how much of an announced price increase was actually realized, what drove the change in pocket revenue
(price, volume, or mix), and which customers are profitable after cost-to-serve.

**Data disclosure:** all data is synthetic and generated by `step1_build_model.py` (fixed seed 2026).
40 customers, 12 products in 3 families (FCC, Hydroprocessing, Specialty), 24 months (FY2025 to FY2026), 2,880 transaction rows.

## Key findings (FY2026 vs FY2025)

| Question | Result |
|---|---|
| Price realization | 5.0% announced list increase realized as 3.7% on invoice and 3.9% at pocket price (78% realization rate) |
| Price leakage | 14.9% of list price lost between list and pocket price (discounts, rebates, freight, payment terms) |
| Revenue bridge | Pocket revenue $136.6M to $143.5M: volume -$5.0M, mix +$6.6M, price +$5.4M |
| Margin | Pocket margin improved from 33.5% to 35.0% |
| Customer profitability | 6 of 40 customers are loss-making after cost-to-serve, erasing $0.71M of profit; the top 34 customers generate 102% of total net profit |
| Renewal pricing | 24 customers sit below the 25% target net margin |

## Methodology

**Pocket price waterfall.** List price less on-invoice discount gives invoice price. Invoice price less volume rebates,
freight ($/ton), and payment-terms cost (invoice revenue x terms days / 365 x cost of capital) gives pocket price.
Leakage = 1 - pocket / list.

**Price realization.** Measured on a same-mix basis so product mix does not distort it: FY2026 tons valued at FY2026 vs
FY2025 per-product prices. Realization rate = realized pocket price change / announced list increase.

**Price-volume-mix bridge (pocket revenue, product level).**
- Volume effect = (total FY26 tons - total FY25 tons) x FY25 average pocket $/t
- Mix effect = sum(FY26 tons_i x FY25 pocket $/t_i) - total FY26 tons x FY25 average pocket $/t
- Price effect = sum(FY26 tons_i x (FY26 pocket $/t_i - FY25 pocket $/t_i))
- The three effects reconcile exactly to the actual change (check cell on the PVM Bridge tab = 0).

**Customer profitability.** Net profit = pocket margin (pocket revenue - standard COGS) - annual cost-to-serve
(technical service, sales coverage). Customers are ranked by net profit, and a cumulative "whale curve" shows how much of
total profit the most profitable customers generate before loss-makers erode it.

**Renewal scenario.** For each customer below the target net margin t, the pure price uplift needed is
dR / R, where dR = (t x R - net profit) / (1 - t) and R is pocket revenue (cost and volume held constant).

## Assumptions (editable, Assumptions tab)
FY2026 list increase 5%, standard cost inflation 3%, cost of capital 8%, target customer net margin 25%.
All inputs are blue; every output is a live formula, so changing an assumption re-flows the whole model.

## Workbook tabs
Summary, Assumptions, Products, Customers, Transactions, Price Waterfall, PVM Bridge, Customer Profitability.

## Run
```bash
pip install numpy pandas openpyxl
bash run.sh
```
